verses.original: δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν Ἔπειτα διὰ ἀνέβην πάλιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα μετὰ Βαρνάβα συμπαραλαβὼν Τίτον καὶ
verses.transliteration: dekatessarōn etōn Epeita dia anebēn palin eis Hierosolyma meta Barnaba symparalabōn Titon kai
verses.literal: Fourteen years vvv later I went up again to Jerusalem accompanied by Barnabas I took Titus {along} also

verses.original: δὲ ἀνέβην κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν καὶ ἀνεθέμην αὐτοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ κηρύσσω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δὲ κατ’ ἰδίαν τοῖς δοκοῦσιν πως μή τρέχω ἢ ἔδραμον εἰς κενὸν
verses.transliteration: de anebēn kata apokalypsin kai anethemēn autois to euangelion ho kēryssō en tois ethnesin de kat’ idian tois dokousin pōs mē trechō ē edramon eis kenon
verses.literal: - I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles But vvv [I spoke] privately to those recognized as leaders [for fear that] vvv I was running or had already run in vain

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Τίτος ὁ σὺν ἐμοί ἠναγκάσθη περιτμηθῆναι ὤν Ἕλλην
verses.transliteration: all’ oude Titos ho syn emoi ēnankasthē peritmēthēnai ōn Hellēn
verses.literal: Yet not even Titus who [was] with me was compelled to be circumcised [even though] he was a Greek

verses.original: δὲ διὰ τοὺς ψευδαδέλφους οἵτινες παρεισῆλθον παρεισάκτους κατασκοπῆσαι ἡμῶν τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ἣν ἔχομεν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα καταδουλώσουσιν ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de dia tous pseudadelphous hoitines pareisēlthon pareisaktous kataskopēsai hēmōn tēn eleutherian hēn echomen en Christō Iēsou hina katadoulōsousin hēmas
verses.literal: [This issue arose] because [some] false brothers - had come in under false pretenses to spy on our - freedom - - in Christ Jesus in order to enslave us

verses.original: εἴξαμεν τῇ ὑποταγῇ οἷς πρὸς οὐδὲ ὥραν ἵνα ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐαγγελίου διαμείνῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: eixamen tē hypotagē hois pros oude hōran hina hē alētheia tou euangeliou diameinē pros hymas
verses.literal: We did {not} give in . . . . . . to [them] for vvv a moment so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you

verses.original: δὲ Ἀπὸ τῶν δοκούντων εἶναί τι ὁποῖοί ἦσαν ποτε οὐδέν διαφέρει μοι Θεὸς οὐ λαμβάνει πρόσωπον ὁ ἀνθρώπου γὰρ οἱ δοκοῦντες προσανέθεντο οὐδὲν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: de Apo tōn dokountōn einai ti hopoioi ēsan pote ouden diapherei moi Theos ou lambanei prosōpon ho anthrōpou gar hoi dokountes prosanethento ouden emoi
verses.literal: But as for the highly esteemed . . . . . . whatever they were . . . vvv makes no difference to me God vvv does not show favoritism . . . . . . . . . - those leaders added nothing to me

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοὐναντίον ἰδόντες ὅτι πεπίστευμαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἀκροβυστίας καθὼς Πέτρος τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: alla tounantion idontes hoti pepisteumai to euangelion tēs akrobystias kathōs Petros tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: vvv On the contrary they saw that I had been entrusted [to preach] the gospel to the uncircumcised just as Peter [ had been ] to the circumcised

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἐνεργήσας Πέτρῳ εἰς ἀποστολὴν τῆς περιτομῆς ἐνήργησεν καὶ ἐμοὶ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: gar ho energēsas Petrō eis apostolēn tēs peritomēs enērgēsen kai emoi eis ta ethnē
verses.literal: For the [One who] was at work in Peter’s . . . apostleship to the circumcised was also at work . . . in my [apostleship] to the Gentiles

verses.original: καὶ γνόντες τὴν χάριν τὴν μοι δοθεῖσάν Ἰάκωβος καὶ Κηφᾶς καὶ Ἰωάννης οἱ δοκοῦντες εἶναι στῦλοι ἔδωκαν ἐμοὶ καὶ Βαρνάβα δεξιὰς κοινωνίας ἵνα ἡμεῖς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη δὲ αὐτοὶ εἰς τὴν περιτομήν
verses.transliteration: kai gnontes tēn charin tēn moi dotheisan Iakōbos kai Kēphas kai Iōannēs hoi dokountes einai styloi edōkan emoi kai Barnaba dexias koinōnias hina hēmeis eis ta ethnē de autoi eis tēn peritomēn
verses.literal: And recognizing the grace [that] I had been given James - Cephas and John those reputed to be pillars gave me and Barnabas [the] right hand of fellowship so that we [ should go ] to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised

verses.original: μόνον ἵνα μνημονεύωμεν τῶν πτωχῶν αὐτὸ τοῦτο ὃ καὶ ἐσπούδασα ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: monon hina mnēmoneuōmen tōn ptōchōn auto touto ho kai espoudasa poiēsai
verses.literal: [They] only [asked us] to remember the poor the very thing - - I was eager to do

verses.original: Ὅτε Κηφᾶς ἦλθεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν δὲ ἀντέστην κατὰ αὐτῷ πρόσωπον ὅτι ἦν κατεγνωσμένος
verses.transliteration: Hote Kēphas ēlthen eis Antiocheian de antestēn kata autō prosōpon hoti ēn kategnōsmenos
verses.literal: When Cephas came to Antioch however I opposed [him] to his face because he stood condemned

verses.original: γὰρ πρὸ τινας τοῦ ἐλθεῖν ἀπὸ Ἰακώβου συνήσθιεν μετὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν δὲ ὅτε ἦλθον ὑπέστελλεν καὶ ἀφώριζεν ἑαυτόν φοβούμενος τοὺς ἐκ περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: gar pro tinas tou elthein apo Iakōbou synēsthien meta tōn ethnōn de hote ēlthon hypestellen kai aphōrizen heauton phoboumenos tous ek peritomēs
verses.literal: For before certain men - came from James he used to eat with the Gentiles But when they arrived he began to draw back and separate himself for fear of those in [the] circumcision [ group ]

verses.original: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ συνυπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ ὥστε τῇ αὐτῶν ὑποκρίσει καὶ Βαρνάβας συναπήχθη
verses.transliteration: kai hoi loipoi Ioudaioi kai synypekrithēsan autō hōste tē autōn hypokrisei kai Barnabas synapēchthē
verses.literal: - The other Jews vvv joined him in his hypocrisy . . . so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ὅτε εἶδον ὅτι οὐκ ὀρθοποδοῦσιν πρὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου εἶπον τῷ Κηφᾷ ἔμπροσθεν πάντων Εἰ σὺ ὑπάρχων Ἰουδαῖος ζῇς ἐθνικῶς καὶ οὐκ Ἰουδαϊκῶς πῶς ἀναγκάζεις τὰ ἔθνη ἰουδαΐζειν
verses.transliteration: All’ hote eidon hoti ouk orthopodousin pros tēn alētheian tou euangeliou eipon tō Kēpha emprosthen pantōn Ei sy hyparchōn Ioudaios zēs ethnikōs kai ouk Ioudaikōs pōs anankazeis ta ethnē ioudaizein
verses.literal: - When I saw that vvv they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel I said - to Cephas in front of [them] all If you who are a Jew live like a Gentile and not like a Jew how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς Ἰουδαῖοι φύσει καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἐθνῶν Ἁμαρτωλοί
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis Ioudaioi physei kai ouk ex ethnōn Hamartōloi
verses.literal: We [who are] Jews by birth and not vvv Gentile sinners

verses.original: δὲ εἰδότες ὅτι ἄνθρωπος οὐ δικαιοῦται ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἐὰν μὴ διὰ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐπιστεύσαμεν εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ἵνα δικαιωθῶμεν ἐκ πίστεως Χριστοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ πᾶσα σάρξ δικαιωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de eidotes hoti anthrōpos ou dikaioutai ex ergōn nomou ean mē dia pisteōs Iēsou Christou kai hēmeis episteusamen eis Christon Iēsoun hina dikaiōthōmen ek pisteōs Christou kai ouk ex ergōn nomou hoti ex ergōn nomou ou pasa sarx dikaiōthēsetai
verses.literal: - know that a man vvv is not justified by works of [the] law but . . . by faith in Jesus Christ So we, too . . . have believed in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law because by works of the law no one . . . . . . will be justified

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ ζητοῦντες δικαιωθῆναι ἐν Χριστῷ αὐτοὶ καὶ εὑρέθημεν ἁμαρτωλοί ἆρα Χριστὸς διάκονος ἁμαρτίας μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: de Ei zētountes dikaiōthēnai en Christō autoi kai heurethēmen hamartōloi ara Christos diakonos hamartias mē genoito
verses.literal: But if while we seek to be justified in Christ we ourselves . . . are found to be sinners does that make Christ a minister of sin vvv Certainly not

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ οἰκοδομῶ πάλιν ταῦτα ἃ κατέλυσα συνιστάνω ἐμαυτὸν παραβάτην
verses.transliteration: gar ei oikodomō palin tauta ha katelysa synistanō emauton parabatēn
verses.literal: - If I rebuild . . . what - I have already torn down I prove myself [to be] a lawbreaker

verses.original: γὰρ διὰ νόμου ἐγὼ ἀπέθανον νόμῳ ἵνα ζήσω Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar dia nomou egō apethanon nomō hina zēsō Theō
verses.literal: For through [the] law I died to [the] law so that I might live to God

verses.original: συνεσταύρωμαι Χριστῷ δὲ ἐγώ οὐκέτι ζῶ δὲ Χριστός ζῇ ἐν ἐμοὶ δὲ ὃ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί ζῶ ἐν πίστει τῇ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντός με καὶ παραδόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: synestaurōmai Christō de egō ouketi zō de Christos zē en emoi de ho nyn zō en sarki zō en pistei tē tou Huiou tou Theou tou agapēsantos me kai paradontos heauton hyper emou
verses.literal: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live but Christ lives in me - The [life] vvv I live in [the] body I live by faith - in the Son - of God who loved me and gave Himself up . . . for me

verses.original: Οὐκ ἀθετῶ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ γὰρ εἰ δικαιοσύνη διὰ νόμου ἄρα Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν δωρεὰν
verses.transliteration: Ouk athetō tēn charin tou Theou gar ei dikaiosynē dia nomou ara Christos apethanen dōrean
verses.literal: vvv I do not set aside the grace - of God For if righteousness [comes] through the law then Christ died for nothing
